SPA Fixture

Testing pushState updates without full reload.

This single-page fixture provides enough stable reading content for SmartScope before and after client-side navigation. The mode engine should keep a scoped mode active across history updates while still verifying that the target content root is safe and meaningful.

Local deterministic content keeps the test hermetic and avoids depending on third-party pages. The paragraphs are intentionally long enough to exercise scoring, reapply, and cleanup behavior without introducing unrelated layout complexity.

AURA_SPA_MARKER_PAGE_1. SPA page 1 includes readable text inside the dynamic region so scoped mode can continue to target article-like content after the page mutates.
